newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber ends firmer, off early highs.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber ends firmer, off early highs.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly firmer across the board on Thursday, but off early highs as private investors' technical buying lost steam ahead of the close, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.1 yen per kg higher. Benchmark February was 0.3 yen firmer at 139.6 yen.

Activity was lacklustre. Prices edged higher for most of the day, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, but the benchmark February failed to stay above 140 yen at the close. "Profit-taking above 140 yen for the benchmark put a lid on further gains," one trader said.
